name: The Lodge & Spa at Brush Creek Ranch
insider_take: This 30,000-acre working cattle ranch sits at 6,000 feet elevation in the Sierra Madre Mountains, offering an authentic Western experience where luxury meets rugged wilderness.
whats_special: The Lodge features North America's first Forbes Five-Star ranch spa, housed in a stunning glass pavilion. Guests can participate in real cattle drives, fly fishing on private waters of the North Platte River, and enjoy farm-to-table dining featuring ranch-raised beef. The property maintains an active herd of 5,000 cattle across its vast acreage.
pro_tip: Book the signature "Cowboy for a Day" experience during summer months - you'll work alongside real ranch hands and enjoy a chuck wagon lunch prepared over an open fire.
dont_miss: The Medicine Bow National Forest borders the ranch, offering world-class hiking and wildlife viewing. Take the scenic drive to nearby Snowy Range Pass for breathtaking alpine views, or explore the historic mining town of Encampment just 30 minutes away, where the Grand Encampment Museum showcases Wyoming's copper mining heritage.
pros: Luxury working ranch experience with authentic Western activities
World-class spa and wellness facilities in stunning natural setting
All-inclusive gourmet dining with farm-to-table cuisine
Exclusive outdoor adventures including fly fishing, horseback riding, and wildlife experiences
cons: Remote location in Wyoming requires significant travel planning
Ultra-luxury pricing reflects premium all-inclusive experience
